_comment: A film preset. convert.cube renders Apple Log straight through a stock baked from spektrafilm
(luts/film/CHANGELOG.txt); the stock's curve is the only tone curve. Each clip's exposure
and white balance are metered in linear before the cube
(scripts/solve-exposure.py) against match.reference_stops; correct.* still adds on top.
Kodachrome 64 reversal on Super 8, matched to 1950s Kodachrome slides: dense, rich reds,
clean daylight whites. finish.gauge adds the format: small-gauge resolution,
18 fps, gate weave and a vignette. Heavy grain, shaped by the stock like every preset
(grain_prefix), and a wide glow: halation spreads as far on
the tiny frame, so its radius is a larger share of the picture. No sharpening.
name: Super 8 Kodachrome
